request.style: English, soul, male baritone solo with gospel choir, electric piano, Hammond organ, bass guitar, drums, snare, solemn and urgent, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the wilderness of Judea he stood
Preaching that the kingdom has come near
Repent is the only truth he told
A voice calling out in the wild

[Pre-Chorus]
Jerusalem and Judea went out
To the river where the waters flowed
Confessing sins in the Jordan stream
While the Pharisees watched with pride

[Chorus]
Kingdom near the voice is saying
Prepare the way of the Lord
Make the paths straight and true
For a mightier one approaches

[Verse]
Clothed in camel's hair and leather belt
Eating locusts and wild honey
He warned the vipers to flee wrath
Produce fruit worthy of change

[Pre-Chorus]
Do not say we have Abraham
For stones can become his children
The axe is laid at the root
Every tree must bear good fruit

[Chorus]
Kingdom near the voice is saying
Prepare the way of the Lord
Make the paths straight and true
For a mightier one approaches

[Bridge]
I am not worthy to carry sandals
He will baptize with Spirit and fire
The winnowing fork is in his hand
Gathering wheat into the barn

[Outro]
Burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire
The kingdom is near
